title: GojiberryAI MCP plus GrokBot: 97 prospects and 1 demo in 24h
summary: GojiberryAI CEO case study wiring GrokBot to the Gojiberry MCP and LinkedIn to define ICP, enrich 97 prospects, personalize outreach, and book one demo within 24 hours, with a Calendly Slack screenshot as evidence.
